rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_HTTPS_Signature {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing over HTTPS based on traffic pattern and string entropy"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        date = "2026-04-11"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $beacon_uri = "\\/\\?" wide ascii
        $junk_param = "&[a-zA-Z]{4}=" wide ascii
        $beacon_header = "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.1; WOW64; Trident/7.0; rv:11.0) like Gecko" wide ascii
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x1603 and
        $beacon_uri and
        for any i in (1..10): ($junk_param[i] and @junk_param[i] > @beacon_uri) and
        $beacon_header
}
